_comment: Reed's grounded tool registry — the SINGLE source of truth for what Reed can actually call, what it costs, and when to use it. Updated by reed-research + reed-higgsfield-tester. status: live | depleted_until | manual | check | capped. Reed's spine (reed-generate.js) reads this to pick the cheapest tool that clears the bar. Last grounded: 2026-06-02 (Higgsfield Starter renews ~2026-06-12).

renewal.note: Until renewal, Higgsfield is depleted. Images = OpenArt (manual, Reed writes the prompt). Video = fal Seedance (paid, capped). After renewal, Higgsfield is the workhorse for both.

budget.note: Hard caps. fal Seedance ~$1.20/4s. Telegram spend notice after each paid run (SI-31/32). Never regenerate an identical brief — cache by brief hash.

gotchas: no --custom_reference_id / no soul-id support — use Soul V2 for faces
higgsfield_nano_banana_pro.use_when: primary IMAGE workhorse once renewed (sunk subscription cost)

gotchas: text-only, no --image input — gym always from text description
higgsfield_soul_v2.use_when: any image needing a known face once renewed
higgsfield_soul_v2.ref: two-pass: Soul V2 (face) -> Nano Banana Pro (gym grounding)

higgsfield_kling3.use_when: premium VIDEO once renewed (free under subscription — prefer over paid fal)

higgsfield_seedance_fast.use_when: bulk/daily video once renewed (free under subscription)

gotchas: PAID per call — cap to daily budget
fal_seedance.use_when: VIDEO needed in the next 10 days (Higgsfield depleted). CAP strictly.

gotchas: NO programmatic access — Reed CANNOT auto-generate here
openart_nano_banana.use_when: images in the next 10 days: Reed writes a taste-gated, paste-ready prompt to ready/prompts/ for Paul to run in OpenArt

strengths: won the pro-photo comparison vs nano_banana_2 (2026-05-14)
gotchas: verify key/credits before relying on it
gpt_image_2.use_when: fallback image path if key is live — verify first

gotchas: spending cap blocks it — raise at ai.studio/spend
gemini_nano_banana.use_when: only if Paul lifts the Gemini spend cap

selection_doctrine: 1. Consult the Taste Map first (checkRejection) — never generate a rejected style.
2. Pick the CHEAPEST tool that clears the quality bar for the format.
3. Subscription (Higgsfield, when live) beats pay-per-use (fal) — the cost is already sunk.
4. Next 10 days: image brief -> write paste-ready OpenArt prompt (no spend); video brief -> fal Seedance (capped).
5. Never regenerate an identical brief — check the cache.
6. After any PAID run, post spend to Telegram and decrement the daily budget.

motion_control.what: Transfer motion from a reference clip onto a STATIC image (animate a photo with a real movement). Use case: animate a still Coach Paul / Logan / technique frame with real boxing motion. Distinct from text-to-video.
motion_control.open_question: Does Higgsfield Kling 3.0 (Starter, renews ~2026-06-12) expose a motion-control mode (reference-video -> static-image transfer)? If YES we already have it. If NO, that's the real gap.

candidates.higgsfield_kling3: CHECK FIRST — already paid under Starter ($15, ~533 Kling videos/mo = ~50x the volume of Kling-official Standard). Verify whether it exposes a motion-control mode (not in Reed's bible/map — likely a gap). If it does, we already have motion-control, buy nothing.
candidates.kling_official_standard: klingai.com first-party (Kuaishou). $6.99/mo = 660 credits/mo. Kling 3.0 costs 6-12 cr/sec (720p-1080p+audio) -> ~10 good 1080p clips/mo after the documented 3-5x regen wastage. UNCONFIRMED: whether Standard includes Kling 3.0 + motion-control or those are Pro-gated ($25.99). NO API in consumer tier (web-app manual). VERDICT: do NOT buy for plain video (overlaps Higgsfield ~50x worse on volume). ONLY worth it if (a) Higgsfield lacks motion-control AND (b) Standard tier actually includes 3.0+motion-control. Verify both on live klingai.com before spending. (pricing per 2026 third-party blogs, not first-party-confirmed)
candidates.luma_kling3: reseller free tier (~3000 cr = ~6 1080p clips), real account + phone verify. LEGIT, zero ToS risk. STATUS: HELD per Paul 2026-06-02 — do not act until Paul confirms.
candidates.anijam_kling26: free tier (Kling 2.6, 600 cr = ~3 clips), Google login. Legit free-tier candidate, lower model than 3.0.
candidates.pixverse: REJECTED 2026-06-02 — the 'unlimited' path is temp-email + incognito + cross-referral credit-minting = ToS violation, fragile (vendor actively patches it), account-ban risk, anti-sovereignty. Valid technique (motion control), sketchy delivery. Forgotten-Shelf rule: keep the technique, drop the delivery.

motion_control.source: YouTube 'free Kling 3.0 motion control' (sponsored/funnel video, PicLumen). Signal = the motion-control capability; noise = the free-credits hype + the loophole.
motion_control.note: Reality: Paul already gets ~533 Kling videos/mo via Higgsfield Starter ($15). Free tiers only matter for (1) the depleted pre-renewal gap, (2) motion-control mode IF Higgsfield lacks it.
